expr: y_def = lognpdf(2); y_s = lognpdf(2, 0, 1); y_v = lognpdf([0 1 2 5], 0, 1); y_neg = lognpdf(-1, 0, 1); y_at0 = lognpdf(0, 0, 1); y_sig0 = lognpdf(2, 0, 0); y_signeg = lognpdf(2, 0, -1);
